topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon a post online, a photo of someone's arm, my art inked permanently on their skin. At first, I felt a strange thrill—seeing my work so intimately embraced. But the excitement was fleeting, replaced by a deep unease. I hadn't given permission, hadn’t even known. I wonder now about the person who chose my art, what part of my creation spoke to them so profoundly. I feel a need to reach out, to understand, to perhaps guide them to the right way of honoring the work we pour our hearts into. It’s a complex moment, one that leaves me pondering the boundaries between flattery and something more unsettling.
